name: (Horned Dragon) Horn Projectile
text:
Frequency once per round

---
Effect The dragon hurls a fragment of its horn at a target within 40 feet. The target takes the same damage as the dragon's horn Strike and must attempt a Reflex save save.

---
Critical Success The target takes no damage.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is Immobilized as the horn fragment pins them to the nearest surface.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target takes double damage and 2d6 persistent,bleed damage as the fragment pierces their body.
